caption: The mask marks a 64×64 hole, which is 6.25% of the 256×256 image, and keeps m = 1 at missing pixels. After the generator predicts the hole and the composite keeps the visible pixels, an MSE of 16 on 8-bit pixels gives PSNR 36.09 dB.

spec.title: Inpainting a 64×64 hole
spec.aria: A 256×256 input image is covered by a mask with m = 1 over a 64×64 hole, 6.25% of the pixels; the generator predicts the full image, the composite keeps visible pixels and takes the prediction inside the hole, and the result scores PSNR 36.09 dB at MSE 16.
